extracted.name: Hot Pepper Jelly BBQ Sauce
extracted.description: This hot pepper jelly BBQ sauce is enhanced with ketchup, vinegar, Worcestershire, mustard, and garlic and tastes great on almost any meat.
instruction_lines: Stir together hot pepper jelly, ketchup, white vinegar, Worcestershire sauce, mustard, and garlic in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly before brushing on meat.
